nom: e.l.f. Cosmetics Bright Icon Vitamin C + E + Ferulic Serum

avis.texte: This product smells like chicken strips and left my skin super oily.

It did what it needed to to but with the addition of making me break out like never before. Yes my dark spot were pretty much gone but after using it for not even a week I started breaking out mainly on my cheeks, forehead and even a little on my jawline/neck

quite sticky and smells a bit funky, but i'm sure it would be great for people who don't have sensory issues (which i do). i also found the dropper to be very poorly designed; it's super difficult to press down, and barely picks up any product. i like most elf products, but this one was a miss for me.
HORRIBLE smell. I had it on my face for 3 minutes & had to go wash my face. The consistency is also super greasy.

I had to return this item due to the smell. I couldnt use it more than once. It smells like motor oil as other reviewers have mentioned. Its nonoily and easily soaks into the skin but the smell lasts for a couple hours after application. Its headache inducing. Hopefully they can improve this products smell in the future.

Of the whole elf skin care line, this is my least favorite. I got it in a bundle with rhe moisturizer and eye cream. This stuff has a weird smell and its pretty grwasy. When I use it I just use a little bit, a little goes a long way.

This is a dupe for a product from another brand that sells for nearly $200/oz. Once the patent for that product expired, e.l.f. jumped on it and started selling the same formula. This stuff is amazing! I'm super sensitive to scents. The scent of this doesn't bother me at all and I can't smell it once I put on the other products in my morning routine. If your face is sticky or greasy after putting this on, you're using too much. You only need a few drops. Let it fully absorb for a few min before layering on additional serums or moisturizers.
I felt like I was putting oil on my face and it smelled like it too

I wanted to try a more affordable vitamin c product after using the sunday riley for months, but this isnt it. I dont feel like the elf product absorbs into the skin, and my face felt sticky to the touch for up to 30 minutes afterwards. I also feel like it pills off when adding make up on top. Will have to go back to Sunday Riley!

I love this product and noticed a nice plumpness in my face after using it. It works great to refresh my full looking skin. It works great when paired with the holy hydration! Cleanser and moisturizer. It can slightly irritate the eyes when applying to face but other than that it has made my dull sling look alive and refreshed. I love this product and will continue using it as long as the company sells it!

I got this in one of the ulta mini sets, and the serum itself is lightweight BUT a bit greasy, and I do feel it has a brightening effect. However, it does have a smell! I can smell it on my face for like 20 minutes after application. And I'm not sure if I'm insane, but it smells like smoked salmon to me. There is a fishy smell and it's almost annoying me so much I don't want to use it anymore. If you have a sensitive nose, you may notice a smell too.
This brought live back into my skin! It is a thicker oil but my skin absorbed it like crazy. My skiin looks blumper and feels nice an hydrated!

I've been using this for just a couple of weeks and I can already see a difference in my skin. It appears clearer and brighter and generally healthier since I began using it. The texture of the product is silky and soaks into my skin quickly. I also really like the top/applicator; it makes it really easy to dispense the right amount of product.
This product is left my skin shiny and it gave me cystic bumps and the greasy works with the oils in your pores to create pimples..

avis.titre: Lightweight, brightening, and leaves my skin looking heal...
avis.texte: I really enjoyed adding the serum to my skin care routine. If it was lightweight. Absorbs quickly. And doesn't leave my skin feeling sticky. After using it consistently my skin looked brighter and smoother.
I really wanted to like this but it was not for me. It was really greasy, it was like putting oil on your face. It broke me out and made my face itch. The smell was really bad.
Tried using this myself and my skin was hypersensitive to it. I am on the paler side which may have had something to do with it. Works great for my wife though.
The formula on this is easy to apply no irritation and it lasts on my skin all day no issues I would repurchase. Great product. Give it a try and see for yourself!
This is the best vitamin C serum that I've ever used. It gives my skin a great texture, glow, and appearance. It's a big bottle, and the consistency is very good too
I love using the e.l.f. SKIN Bright Icon Vitamin C + E + Ferulic Serum! This makes my skin so much brighter and gives my face so much life! It's also so easy to use and mix into a skin care routine!
It smells like bergamot and cinnamon, it's musty and the smell lingers. It's also terrible with moisturizer. Super greasy and I had to wash my face 3 times.

avis.titre: The second product I've ever returned....really didn't like.
avis.texte: I did not like this serum at all. First of all, it smells like cinnamon orange, which isn't terrible, but the scent lingers all day and in the summer, wasn't what I wanted to smell all day. Second, it's both sticky and greasy at the same time and absolutely did not absorb, even hours later. I was so excited that the formula seemed to mimic the brand that's about 10x the price, but this wasn't worth it and I ended up returning it after three uses----this is only the second thing I've ever returned to Ulta.
This serum is oily and smells like motor oil. I had to return it and go back to my old favorite.
I'm pretty impressed with this. The serum has a lightweight texture and absorbs quickly without feeling greasy or sticky. This is definitely worth trying
I love this product. it makes me skin look so glowy and feels very soft. will be purchasing again

It might work for others just not me, it left me feeling extra greasy. I already have combination skin and this just add to it. It has a pipette type dispenser so it's easy to use and will stay sterile, I'm just not a fan of the greasy ness because then it'll leave me to breakout more.
Love this product. My brown age spots are slowly disappearing. Also helps my fine lines disappear.

avis.titre: Start with the smaller size just in case
avis.texte: Tried using this myself and my skin was hypersensitive to it. I am on the paler side which may have had something to do with it. Works great for my wife though, so is suggest getting the smaller version or trying a friend's first
It's so glowy and leaves my skin feeling plump and bouncy. love it
I'm not saying it doesn't work, but I am saying that it straight up smells like bacon. It's a VERY strong scent! Not planning to repurchase after I run out 🤷🏻‍♀️
Glowy skin & lightweight product!! Staple to my everyday makeup routine

My skin is combination and I worry about serums being too heavy, but this is lovely and I've really noticed a difference in my skin being clearer and brighter. It doesn't leave a sticky residue, absorbs quickly and my skin seems to love it. Great price point as well and the ferulic acid complements the vitamin c nicely. Tried the mini version but now the bigger bottle will become a staple product of mine. People have complained about the smell but I really didn't notice anything unpleasant - I think vitamin c serums have to have a smell usually. Highly recommend.
Favorite daytime serum. It's smells so good and helps my skin look a little brighter
I liked how this product leaves my face. I definitely saw changes in my skin. More bright and smooth. It smells citrusy and does not leave my face sticky or anything like that.

I got a sample size in my Ipsy box so I could try before committing to the full size and glad I did. It stinks! I was hoping this would be a good alternative to the skin ceuticals (which also smells a little funky, but more like tobacco), but absolutely not with this smell. So unfortunate.

The texture is light & just seeps into your skin! There's not really any residue, but it makes the skin so glowy. I love how easy the product is to dispense & it really eliminates my scars! No more acne scar breakouts!
Does what it says... brightens and made my skin glow! Easy to use and comfortable on my skin. SPF over the top and made a good base for make up. Highly recommended 👌

Have you ever been in a place that makes jerky? Because that's what this smells like. I love how it feels on my skin but hate the smell so much, I never use it. Can't keep my nose plugged the whole time I use it!!

I've only been using this for about a week, but it does actually seem to make the fine wrinkles on my cheeks less noticeable. I'm in my seventh decade of living dangerously and I do like this stuff. It's going to be on my list to always have around!
I like the sleek dropper bottle! The formula is great and absorbs into the skin nicely! I love to mix it with the elf face cream. Leaves a nice healthy glow and radiance.
This serum gives my skin a fresh glow and helps even out my tone. It feels lightweight and absorbs quickly, leaving my skin looking brighter and healthier/
I have this on subscription and use it every other day on my face but every night on my neck! It's done wonders for me!
I really liked this product. it was lightweight, absorbs quickly, and made my skin look brighter and more even. Great quality for the price, a little goes a long way, and I even love the smell of it

Unfortunately this bunch of products did not work on my skin and made me break out in a rash all over my face that took overly a month to go away and hindered me from trying other products. If you have sensitive skin, pass on these.

avis.titre: Solid serum at an affordable price.
avis.texte: I've been using the e.l.f vitamin c + e serum and overall I really like it. I have dry/not sensitive skin and it's been a great lightweight option. It absorbs quickly and surprisingly wasn't oily. The scent didn't bother me despite the mixed reviews. Only con was I didn't like how it felt on my hands after applying. On my face it was comfortable and I had no skin irritation.

avis.titre: Got a mini as a freebie
avis.texte: I chose this as a freebie onetime. Seems gentle and smells good. Not sure if it does anything.

This is a new must have in my skin care routine. It makes my fave look glowing when I go with no makeup for the day. I even love the way it feels when I'm applying it. It goes on smoothly and feels like a light serum. It's like you can actually feel it making your skin brighter when you're using it.

avis.titre: Wanted to like it but it's a No for me.
avis.texte: I bought this to finally try it and sadly it didn't work for me the smell was awful and as soon as I'd put it on it would sting my face. I had to stop using it. I don't know if I got a bad batch or if others have had this experience. But yeah sadly it's a No for me.
I bought this weeks ago, and it's excellent. The applicator is unique, and the liquid is orange—just the way I like it. It has a very strong orange scent, but it's pleasant.

I wanted to love this but it's okay, the scent is very chemical like but I can appreciate how it absorbed into the skin nicely, I have combo/sensitive skin and it didn't bother my skin at all! I really like the packaging itself I love the bottle but because of the scent I'm not sure if I would reach for this very everyday.

After reading some of the reviews on the product I checked the ingredients list. It has Sodium Hydroxide which is a main ingredient in hair relaxers. This may be why some users complained of burning in combination with other ingredients. I have sensitive skin and I have learned the hard way to remember to read the ingredients list.

avis.titre: Easy to use and not strong!
avis.texte: Easy to use packaging that holds a lot of serum. Good smooth consistency and I can see it working on my dark spots after a month of using it. No odd smell or stinging.
Didn't notice insane results so not sure if I'd repurchase again but it didn't make me break out which is rare
This product stinks and not nice!!! Left my skin feeling bumpy and itchy
Burned and dried my face out a lot. I have those burn marks by my eyes like as if I was on the beach.

avis.titre: Cannot recommend the Elf Vitamin C Serum
avis.texte: I wanted to love this product. It has a great ingredient deck with actives I want in my routine. This is a value price and it seems to be shelf stable when open for awhile. I cannot recommend this Elf serum because it severely irritated my face and chest. I had a similar reaction to the Skincueticals GOAT product with red splotches, irritation, and what appears to be hives. Vit C products I use successfully: Drunk Elephant, Sunday Riley, Derma E, Paula's Choice, and Dermalogica.
This product is great I haven't found a vitamin c oil that doesn't break me out until this one! It makes me glow I absolutely love this product and would recommend it to everyone.
I found it a little sticky going on but I use my cream over it and it's fine. I do love the product! Smells a little funny.
I use morning and night! Leave my skin so hydrating and a nice shine! I have truly noticed a difference in my skin brightness and texture

I wanted to like this product because the price point is better than my usual product. However, it makes my face feel very sticky and the smell is so bad I dreaded using it. I think it's supposed to be citrusy, but it's a failure. Back to my normal tried and true!

avis.titre: The e.l.f SKIN Bright Icon Vitamin C + E + Ferulic
avis.texte: I recently tried the e.l.f skin bright icon Vitamin C + E + Ferulic Serum and I'm actually impressed. First of all, the formula feels super lightweight and absorbs really quickly into the skin without feeling greasy at all. It layers well under moisturizer and makeup, which I love for my morning routine. After using it consistently, my skin started to look more even and a little more radiant.
I absolutely love this serum! Leaves my face feeling bright and light! It moisturizes and refreshes my skin every day. Perfect for my aging skin (going to be 40 this year)

If you want an effective serum to brighten up your skin, this is great. It's a fraction of the price of other higher end formulas but it's still effective. It absorbs well and it plays nicely with other skincare. Will be a continued user, please don't discontinue it.
Tried this serum, not the best smell (would prefer not to have any smell at all). Smells plastic/Metallic. Wouldnt buy again.

I tried to like product, not only did it not dry down and stayed sticky on my face but the smell is unreal. I dont see how this even passed product testing. It smells like a mix of beef jerky and hot dog water. It is unbearable.
I haven't noticed a difference so far but it feels good on my face. It smells like campfire smoke though so I'm not sure if I will be ordering again
LLLLLLLLLOOOOOOVVVVVVVVEEEEEEEEEEE THISSS SOOOO FLIPPING MUCH OOOOMMMMGGGG

This product felt really good on the skin and I had high hopes. I didn't mind the smell, but after a a few weeks of use it caused me very painful breakouts across my nose and cheeks. It just doesn't work for me.
Delish scent, easy on, no residue or build up. Heals uneven color and blemishes. Love it!
Definitely notice a smoother feel after a couple days of use. Does not leave an oily texture the next day. I would def by this for the value and cost.

This smells like feet. I got used to it, but if you're sensitive to that, be aware. i have pretty sensitive skin and was switching from a THD Vit C to this and was concerned that I would have a reaction. I noticed some light, temporary tingling but not redness/irritability. a good affordable option.

avis.titre: A solid addition to my morning routine
avis.texte: I was really excited to try this serum because of its ingredient list (vitamin C, E, and Ferulic acid). Such a powerful combination for brightening the skin! I really liked the texture of the serum. It's lightweight and absorbs pretty quickly. It also doesn't feel too greasy, which I appreciate. It also sat nicely under my morning moisturizer and SPF. Didn't pill at all, which is usually my biggest struggle with vitamin C serums. The only downside for me is that it left my skin a little tacky. Not that you can't get used to the feeling though. Also, like most vitamin C products, make sure to store it in a cool, dry place so it stays fresh. Overall, a great product for its price and a solid addition to a morning routine.

I got it as a free birthday gift so I'm happy I'm not out the money. This has an awful smell to it and it made me break out on my face. I'm sad because I love ELF products and was looking for a decent serum. Guess this one isn't for me.
I noticed my skin looking brighter and more awake after about 10 days of consistent use. It's great for everything out minor redness and giving your complexion a fresh and healthy boss
I like using this in the morning with the glow drops. I use it under my eyes and it works wonders!
I just couldn't do the smell. I tried really really hard to mix it with others and moisturizers. It was just like smoked or dried meat. It lasted about 2 minutes before I had to wash it off.

A few months ago I didn't have a skincare routine, and since discovering e.l.f., I decided to try all their products to see how they would work for my skin, as I've been through acne and am very sensitive to it. And I can say that my skin has reacted well to these products; I'm very happy!

avis.titre: great bundled with the other products in the line!
avis.texte: love this product so much! i mix it with the other products i received in this bundle such as the moisturizer and i love them together. the scent isn't very strong and i love the formula on the oil so much! i use this every morning to brighten up my face after i wash it!
Makes my skin look brighter and smells like oranges. Very runny though and drips out of the dropper without squeezing it.
Something in the mix of Bright Icon is doing wonders for my skin. It's powerfully effective!
I have repurchased this product and I use it every morning. Makes my skin glowy all day.
Although my skin did look better, I won't be using this again. I just can't get past the weird smell.

I am on my 4th full size bottle and I have to say, it will have a permanent place in my skincare regimen. It noticeably brightens my skin, has improved tone and texture of my skin and lessened dark spots. The smell is different but not bad and dissipates quickly. And my skin feels protected.

It looks like it is making a difference on my skin. It doesn't have a pleasant smell like other face products and it is tacky on my face. I now know that I was not imagining the weird smell. I read it in two other comments. Im going to go for it and purchase the big bottle♡
I love this vitamin C. I've been using it for quite a few months and can notice my skin is brighter. I use it before holy hydration moisturiser and serum.

I have recently began using this product after switching from a mote expensive brand. It works well. I put it on each morning after triple bounce hyaluronic and before sunscreen. It's thick but I don't have any issues, I just give it time to absorb before layering my sunscreen. I don't notice the smell other reviews mention.
who doesn't love a good vitamin c serum?! this product has both vitamin c AND vitamin e, plus ferulic serum. i love the smell of it too, not too strong. it definitely brightens up my face!

avis.titre: Finally a product that compares to the expensive version
avis.texte: I have tried so so many alternative VItamin C Feurilic serums and have been only disappointed. Unitl now. Not only is the price reasonable, but the product works exactly as the more expensive version. I am hooked and will buy again!

I love this Vitamin C + serum, and I have tried MANY more expensive brands. It's effective and a great price. I layer it after I flood with toners and before my moisturizer and sunscreen under makeup. It has never irritated my skin or effected my skin barrier in a negative way!! Some don't care for the slightly oily consistency, but it is VERY light and absorbs super quick and doesn't leave an oily film on the face. My makeup goes on smooth amd stays put.

avis.titre: Glowy skin in just a few weeks!
avis.texte: I absolutely love this Vitamin C serum! I've been using it consistently and I've already noticed my skin looks brighter, more even, and has such a healthy glow. It absorbs quickly, doesn't feel sticky, and layers really well under my moisturizer and sunscreen.

Loving every component of this product really is like a serum but this leaves the skin super soft I have hydrated and gives light and liveliness to the face with a little is enough and you notice the changes to the days of using it really its consistency is liquid and soft.
After using it twice, it caused irritation in my T zone- dry, red, bumpy itchy skin. The smell is also kind of gross & veryyy strong.

avis.titre: Love it! But hate the dropper on the full-size
avis.texte: I first got the mini version of this and loved the product! I decided to go ahead and get the full size version. The mini version has a regular squeeze dropper to dispense the product but the full size version uses a button type dispenser and I hate it! It never lets me drop out just one drop so I inevitably use too much product. I will continue to use, but I hope ELF considers changing the top to a regular squeeze dropper!

Product does what it's supposed too and is tacky after applying. You just gotta let your skin absorb it and dry then put on your moisturizer. The smell tho…. Horrible. Straight up smells like smoked meat. The smell goes away after a bit so no worries on that. I'm debating on buying it again.

I liked the product, but the smell is nauseating. Thought I had a bad bottle but read other reviews noting the distaste of the smell. I tried using a couple tomes but just couldn't get past the awful scent.

So glad elf offers this travel size. This serum surprised me with its effectiveness. It really made a difference in the brightness and smoothness of my skin. I've now bought the full size several times.

I really liked the packaging, it's very easy to apply. There were no side effects, and my skin began to recover and glow. It works well with other products. It keeps my skin looking fresh and radiant for a long time. Comfort for all skin types.
Love the fact that this serum incorporates hyaluronic and vitamin C….perfect

I love the packaging and how adorable it looks like but i hate the smell. The texture is greasy and you have to be very careful on how much you are putting otherwise it will leave your skin sticky and orange even after moisturizer. Overall a good product but was not a big fan.
Great affordable serum, makes my skin so glowy and bright. Feels amazing, does not feel sticky, super light and refreshing. I love that it's cruelty free.
I love the serum, it makes my face glow and makes my skin smooth.

First off..I had a mini version of this...absolutely loved how it brightened the tone of my skin..so I ordered the full size. The dispenser top doesn't work. So I refill my mini with this. Other than the dispenser the product is a favorite!
It breaks easily i dropped it and jy broke i cut my foot on the sharp plastic

avis.titre: I'm not sure about this product
avis.texte: I have only used this serum for about a week. So far, I am not a big fan. I will give it time and hopefully I will see a difference in my dark spots. I can say for certain that I do not like the fragrance of this serum. I normally love all the e.l.f. products that I have bought. This one has not lived up to the other products I have used.

I use this serum after I was my face in the morning before moisturizer. I notice that it really brightens my skin and it makes me glow. The only con is the smell. Other people i tbe reviews describe it as rubbery or a salmon type smell, but I saw someone on reddit described the smell as hot dog water and omg that's exactly it !! It smells like hot dog water. I'm going to use it as long as I can stand the smell, but please ELF, do something about that. Lol
This stuff right here makes your face glow and feels smooth and has a good smell.
I wish the dropper wouldn't get stuck as it usually does which kind of sucks. The serum is very hydrating and absorbs pretty quickly. Gives a nice brightening tone.

This skin serum is luxurious and has the most intriguing smell. It's kind of earthy, citrusy and has hints of clove. It feels so nice on the skin and doesn't leave a greasy feel. I genuinely feel like this has improved the overall brightness of my skin! I like that it comes in a glass bottle and the price is really reasonable for a solid product!
This is a very affordable vitamin C serum that doesn't feel sticky! Really like it so far and hasn't irritated my skin.
I was supposed how hydrating it was! And you can see the brightening effect after a couple of weeks. Totally comparable to a well-known brand, but at a much better price.
Love this! Goes on smooth, feels fresh, has brighten my face, and I look younger.
It seens to work okay for the price , but it smells like smoked salmon… its a little weird . Still light weight on the face though
I love it! It's not sticky and its the perfect consistency, Ive seen a very big difference I love it so much I definitely recommended it!

Amazing results, this vitamin C is really good, I really like the packaging because it's so easy to use and keep the product really well. The texture is liquid and doesn't feel greasy at all. It's absorbed by the skin really fast. Using this for a while I can say that my skin looks so much brighter and smooth. This is a 10/10 affordable skin care serum

avis.titre: The smell is odd but works
avis.texte: Instant hydration, noticeably, smaller pores, and overall color gives cheeks a bouncy feel is oily, but doesn't leave oily residue. I use this once a week and it has helped a lot with my skin issues.
This is a great product I love it so much highly recommend to anyone and everyone
